column1: # The programs Stagepack ships beside the viewer, which it runs as separate processes, unmodified (see
# "Licences" in the README). build/programs.sh dist/<os> checks a build against this list and adds each
# program's licence texts to the build's THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.txt. ${NAME} is a value from build/versions.env.
# folder: the program's folder in dist/<os> and in the install folder
# licence files: its licence texts and notices, separated by spaces, relative to dist/<os> (the same on Linux
# parts: a table of the libraries linked into the program, laid out as build/ffmpeg-sources.tsv (folder, kind,
#   url and ref first, its licence files last); each row whose last column is not - must have its notices in the
#   licence files, under "==== <folder> <url> <ref>". - for a program without such a table
# sources: the source archives, separated by spaces, each mirrored in Stagepack's release assets: a URL (the
#   asset has its file name), NAME=URL (the asset is called NAME), or a NAME alone for an archive the release
#   makes itself (build/fetch.sh ffmpeg-libraries). - when the licence asks for no source (a copyleft licence,
#   GPL, LGPL, AGPL, MPL or EPL, does). The names are those build/fetch.sh gives them in .cache/dl.

column3: MIT, and the licences of the parts it bundles (in its LICENSE)
